test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which year was the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India set up?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1999**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​The **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI),** is a **statutory body **formed under an Act of Parliament, i.e., the **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999 (IRDAI Act 1999)**
 
• It was founded in **1999**.
 
• It is founded for the overall **supervision and development of the Insurance sector in India.**
 
• The body was created on the recommendations of the **Malhotra Committee Report.**
 
• Its headquarter is located in **Hyderabad**.
 
• It regulates under the **Ministry Of Finance.**
 
• **Debasish Panda** is the chairperson of IRDAI.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Organisational Setup:**

 
 
• A Chairman
 
• Five whole-time members
 
• Four part-time members
 
 
 
• **All **the **members** of the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India are **appointed by the Government of India**.
